mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, user_no, name, phone, email, password, avatar, user_type, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (user_no = #{account} OR lower(phone) = lower(#{account}) OR lower(email) = lower(#{account})) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (lower(phone) = lower(#{phone}) OR lower(email) = lower(#{email}))

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.user_no AS user_no, u.name AS member_name, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.status AS user_status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time AS join_time, COALESCE(r.role_code, 'ADMIN') AS role_code, COALESCE(r.role_name, '企业管理员') AS role_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r2.role_code, r2.role_name FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_code = u.tenant_code ORDER BY ur.id LIMIT 1 ) r ON TRUE WHERE u.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND u.user_type = 2 AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC
mapper.sql: u.id AS user_id, u.user_no, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.user_type, u.tenant_code, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, r.role_ids, r.role_codes, r.role_names

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(r2.id::text, ',' ORDER BY ur.id) AS role_ids, string_agg(r2.role_code, ',' ORDER BY ur.id) AS role_codes, string_agg(r2.role_name, '、' ORDER BY ur.id) AS role_names FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_code = u.tenant_code ) r ON TRUE
